name: comment-review
description: Professional editorial practice, applied to the prose in a codebase. Comments and docstrings are claims about code that no test checks, so four read-only reviewers ask of each one whether it is still true of the code it sits on. Because a comment says what code is FOR, checking it against what the code DOES examines the design and not only the sentence -- a module whose docstring announces one subject while the file holds four is an architecture finding that arrived through its prose. Where the code is right, the comment is corrected; where the code is not, the reviewer files a code concern instead of editing the prose to fit. The author approves every replacement, and WRITE proves the executable code byte-identical.
